title: Plan work with the Timeline view
body: ## Open the Timeline view
1. Open your project.
2. Select the **Timeline** tab at the top of the project.
3. Drag tasks to change their start and end dates.
## Share a timeline
Select **Share** to give teammates view access to the Timeline.
![Timeline tab selected, with tasks shown as bars across weeks](timeline.png)

title: Projects 101, Lesson 3: Build your first timeline
objective: Learners will build a project timeline with dependencies for a 4-week launch plan.
body: In this lesson you'll turn your task list into a visual plan.
Practice: open the sample project, select the **Timeline** tab, and set dates for the 6 launch tasks.
Check: your timeline should show 2 dependencies and end by week 4.
Knowledge check: Where do you find the Timeline? (a) Reports (b) the Timeline tab (c) Settings

title: Tooltip: Timeline tab
body: New here? The Timeline tab shows your tasks as bars on a calendar. Drag a bar to reschedule.

title: Set up approvals
body: ## Add an approver
1. Open a task and select **Request approval**.
2. Choose one person as the approver.
3. The approver gets an email and can approve or reject.
Note: each approval step has exactly one approver.

title: Admin quick-start checklist
body: ☐ Set workspace permissions
☐ Decide who can invite guests (guests are on by default)
☐ Set up approval steps for client deliverables
☐ Turn on single sign-on

title: Invite guests to a project
body: Any project member can invite guests.
1. Open the project and select **Invite**.
2. Enter the guest's email and choose **Guest**.

title: Enterprise kickoff workshop, module 2: Reporting
body: Activity (10 min): each team builds a status report for their pilot project.
Facilitator demo: go to **Reports > Export** and choose CSV to share the report with leadership.

title: Keyboard shortcuts
body: | Key | Action |
| N | New task |
| T | Open the Timeline |
| / | Search |

title: Speed up large projects
body: Projects with thousands of tasks can load slowly. Archive completed tasks and split very large projects by phase.
